system.description:
This enhancement bolsters the synthmorph’s tolerance to extremely high temperatures with heatresistant materials, heat sinks, and bulky coolant systems. This modification increases the morph’s Durability by 25% while reducing its Movement Rate by half and modifying COO by –10. Morphs with his augmentation can withstand temperatures up to 500 C.

Source: Eclipse Phase Sunward, p. 166.
